heroBody: We are FKNGROUP. We create our own mobile products, turning everyday needs into focused, thoughtfully designed apps.
gymBody: Plan your workouts, log your sets and follow your progress. A personal training journal built for iPhone.
coinBody: Keep track of accounts, expenses and budgets in one place. Personal finance software, currently in development.
aboutTitle:
Built with purpose.
Made for daily life.
aboutBody: FKNGROUP is the parent brand behind FKNGYM, FKNCOIN and our upcoming apps. We develop and maintain our own software products, with a current focus on native iOS applications. Android versions are planned.
modelValue: Develop and maintain our own mobile products
companyBody: The company behind the products. Registration details and a direct contact for business enquiries.
privacyBody: This website has no account registration, contact forms, advertising trackers or analytics. It stores your selected language in your browser. The hosting provider may process technical access data to deliver the site. Product websites and apps have separate privacy policies. If you contact us by email, your message and contact details are used to respond to your enquiry. Contact the website operator using the company details for privacy requests.
termsBody: This website introduces FKNGROUP and its software projects. Planned products and platforms may change; no release date is promised. This website does not sell products or accept payments. Any app purchases, subscriptions and use are subject to the terms shown by the relevant product and distribution platform. External websites have their own terms and privacy policies.
privacySection1Body: FKN COMPANY LLC operates this corporate website under the FKNGROUP brand. Its contact and registration details are below. This notice covers this website and enquiries sent to its business email, not the separate apps or product websites.
privacySection2Body: There are no accounts, contact forms, payments, advertising trackers or analytics on this website. GitHub Pages hosts the site and logs visitor IP addresses for security. Selecting a language or theme saves that preference in your browser until you clear site data; these preferences are not advertising identifiers.
privacySection3Body: If you email us, we receive your address, message and any information you choose to include. Apple iCloud Mail provides our email service. Providing information is voluntary, but we need a reply address and sufficient context to answer. Please do not send sensitive information that is unnecessary for your enquiry.
privacySection4Body: We use enquiry data to respond to you, based on our legitimate interest in handling business communications. When you request steps towards a contract, processing necessary for those steps is based on that request. Information required by law is processed to meet the applicable legal obligation.
privacySection5Body: Correspondence should be kept only as long as needed to resolve the enquiry and meet applicable legal or dispute-related requirements. GitHub and Apple operate international services; their privacy notices describe their own processing. Contact us for information about the handling of your particular enquiry.
privacySection6Body: Contact the email below to request access, correction, deletion, restriction or other applicable data rights. Where consent is the basis, you may withdraw it. You may complain to the State Audit Office of Georgia or a court. We do not use enquiry data for automated decisions or profiling.
termsSection1Body: FKNGROUP is the public brand of FKN COMPANY LLC. Registration and contact details appear below.
termsSection2Body: This website describes our software projects. Development plans, artwork, platforms and release dates can change. A product marked “In development” is not offered for purchase here. FKNCOIN is described as personal finance software; this website does not offer banking, investment or payment services.
termsSection3Body: No orders, subscriptions or payments are accepted on this website. Any future purchase is governed by the terms and required disclosures presented by the relevant product and distribution platform before purchase. Linked sites have their own terms and privacy notices.
termsSection4Body: These website terms do not exclude any mandatory consumer or data-protection rights under applicable law. For questions or to report inaccurate information, use the business email below.
